lines.name: Architect Server licences
lines.recognitionNote: Right to use: revenue at one point in time, when the keys are delivered and the customer can use the software.

lines.name: Insight Cloud subscription
lines.recognitionNote: Right to access (SaaS): revenue evenly over the 36 months.

lines.name: Insight Cloud overage
lines.recognitionNote: Variable consideration: recognised in the month the extra users are there, at the contract rate.

lines.name: Flow Engine consumption
lines.model: Software on consumption, billed in arrears
lines.recognitionNote: Usage-based fee: revenue as the calls are made. Not part of the committed price.

lines.name: Implementation
lines.recognitionNote: Over time by progress (hours worked against plan). Billing follows the milestones, so the two differ.

lines.name: Training
lines.recognitionNote: Recognised when a training day has been held; billed at the end of that month.

lines.name: Managed operations (Premium)
lines.recognitionNote: Stand-ready service: revenue evenly over the 36 months.

stages.name: Contract signed
stages.does: Reads the signed contract C-4410 with customer, bill-to party, term and price list.
stages.result: Contract C-4410, signed 2026-10-28, 36 months, bill-to Kestrel Group Services GmbH

stages.name: Order
stages.does: Creates sales order SO-90412 with one item per priced position of the contract.
stages.result: SO-90412 with 6 items; overage and consumption are rate items without a quantity

stages.name: Bill of material
stages.does: Derives the bill of material from the order: what is delivered, what is provisioned, what is metered, which service is scheduled.
stages.result: BOM-90412 with 7 items (3 software, 1 overage rate, 3 services)

stages.name: Entitlement check
stages.does: Before anything is delivered: compares the bill of material with what the contract entitles the customer to.
stages.result: 5 of 7 items match; 2 deviations to correct first

stages.name: Delivery
stages.does: Delivers what the bill of material says: licence keys and download, the tenant prepared, meter credentials, the service plan.
stages.result: Delivery 80004417 with four kinds of delivery

stages.name: Goods receipt
stages.does: The customer confirms what arrived. Without this confirmation nothing is billed for the licences.
stages.result: Receipt confirmed by the customer for licences, tenant and meter

stages.name: Entitlement granted
stages.does: Switches the entitlements on: 40 licence keys, 250 users (up to 300 as overage), the API quota.

stages.name: Technical provisioning
stages.does: Creates the tenant in the EU region, connects single sign-on, configures the meter and the roles.

stages.name: Completion message
stages.does: Provisioning reports done; the order items change to fulfilled. Billing only starts after this message.

stages.name: Billing
stages.does: Creates the invoices: licences once, subscription and managed operations monthly in advance, services by milestone or day, consumption and overage monthly in arrears.
stages.result: Invoice plan with the dates from the contract

stages.name: Consumption against billing
stages.does: Compares the metered usage with what was invoiced, for overage and consumption.
stages.result: One difference: December calls were metered 28,400,000 and billed 26,100,000

stages.name: Revenue
stages.does: Posts the revenue schedule: price shared out by stand-alone selling price, then licence at a point in time, subscription and operations evenly, services by progress or day, usage as it arises.

stages.name: Cash receipt
stages.does: Matches the incoming payments of the bank statement to the open invoices.

stages.name: Revenue recognition
stages.does: Closes the period: billed, recognised and collected side by side, contract asset or liability, remaining performance obligations.
stages.result: Period closed with the position of the contract

deviations.what: The bill of material has service level Standard (8x5); the contract says Premium (24x7).
deviations.fix: Set the bill of material item to Premium before delivery.

deviations.what: Billing master data holds rate card RC-2025-A at 0.45 per 1,000 calls; the contract rate is 0.40 (RC-2026-B).
deviations.fix: Assign rate card RC-2026-B in billing master data before the first usage invoice.

n8n.name: Demo 13 (order to cash): software order
n8n.trigger: Webhook: contract signed (POST /webhook/o2c-software with the contract id)
notes: One HTTP Request node per system call, in the order of the process. Every node reads from the system and returns a record; the workflow itself decides nothing.

Three places where a person decides: deviations of the entitlement check (Wait node), the customer's receipt confirmation (Wait node, resumed by the customer portal), the true-up of consumption (Wait node).
The URLs come from environment variables. The seven systems here are fictional; the workflow only shows the order of the calls.
